# GitHub Copilot CLI 1.0.95-2 tool inventory, macOS (Darwin 25), default configuration: no plugins,
# no user MCP servers, no custom instructions (an isolated COPILOT_HOME holding only the login).
# Copilot exposes no tool declaration (none in `copilot help`, session.start, system.message or the
# model-call telemetry), so the first section is the model's report of its declared tools, spelled as
# the session records them (the built-in GitHub MCP server's tools carry its `github-mcp-server-`
# prefix). Later sections add tools observed in real sessions but missing from that report, by the
# host Copilot ran under. Tools from user-installed MCP servers are not part of the inventory; they
# render generically, typed unknown. See examples/TOOL-AUDIT.md for declared / exercised status.
